note: Campground 3 miles from Ellington with ATV, side-by-side, overlanding and hiking trails and two swimming holes in the creeks. The RV sites curve along the camp road east of the entrance; the tent sites are by Logan Creek west of County Road 422. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: operator site $30 hookup sites (30/50 A + water), $20 tent; Park With Us engine 30 back-in RV sites (26x30A, 4x50A, water, no sewer, 55-70 ft) + 10 tent; no dump yet; shower house. Phone 618-444-2112 is the operator's published number (site, engine, Google). Google 4.8/35. Not waterfront kept (RV sites ~70-150 m from Logan Creek across CR 422). Groups written manual; note cleaned.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: posted rate $30/night for hookup sites on the operator's own site (fourcreeksranchcampground.com, 'Copyright (c) 2024', read 2026-11-09) and bookable on its Park With Us engine -> price passes (well under $50, no gateway needed). Presence: working website with phone + Google Maps 'Four Creeks Ranch Campground' 4.8 from 35 reviews, phone +1 618-444-2112, website fourcreeksranchcampground.com, address 291 Co Rd 422, Ellington, MO 63638. RV Life unrated (stored). Good Sam: not stated. Long-stay: none marketed (no weekly/monthly/seasonal rates on the site; the engine's long-term booking is off, one-night minimum) -> five tests not triggered; no occupancy check run.

PHONE: the stored 618-444-2112 (an Illinois area code) is the park's published number: on the operator site ('Text us or call. (618)444-2112'), in the engine's camp record ('telephone':'618-444-2112') and on the Google panel. Kept.

OHV CHARACTER (for awareness, not a drop lead): the site leads with 'Camping, ATVs, OHVs, Horses and Water' and 'Trails for miles for ATVs, Side x Sides, and OHVs of all kinds', but it is a general campground (30 hookup sites, shower house, creek swimming holes, floating nearby) with trails as a side, which the off-road rule keeps (general campground with an OHV side).

WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the site map puts the 30 RV sites in an arc along the camp road east of the entrance; Logan Creek and its branch run west and north of them, with the tent sites 1-10 by the creek. On imagery the creek's gravel bars are ~70 m from site 1 at the nearest and 100-200 m from the rest, with County Road 422 and the camp road between. Only the tent sites are creekside ('PRIMITIVE CAMPING NEXT TO THE CREEKS'). No contrary operator claim for the RV sites.
PIN: stored 37.2532,-90.9257 is Google's point, at the entrance/tent area by the creek; the RV arc is ~100-200 m NE. Within tolerance; no move proposed.
Hipcamp also lists the creek tent camping (hipcamp.com/missouri/four-creeks-campground/creekside-camping, linked from the operator site); the operator's own engine is the booking url.
